name: Unlimited/multi-value Fields Extra Settings
description: Adds extra settings for unlimited/multi-value fields (e.g. per-field display/behaviour options).
project_description:
This modules add extra config to fields that allows you to configure the initial number of items to display for unlimited and multi-values (with cardinality bigger than 1) fields.

 Actual feature 

 
 Set the number of initially visible items to display. 
 
 Coming features 

 
 Set the number for minimum required values. 
 
 Installation and configuration 

 
 
Install Unlimited fields settings module as usual .
 
 
Navigate to the form display of the desired entity. For example, for the "Article" content type:

 Structure >> Content Types >> Manage form display .
 
 
Locate the field you want to configure. Ensure the field has a cardinality of "Unlimited" or greater than 1
 
 
Enter the desired number of items in the Number of values to display setting

 and save
 
 
 Support 

 
 The 8.x-1.x branch support only unlimited fields. 
 The 2.0.x branch support unlimited and multi-values fields.
